QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_5

question.text: In Chapter 6 Example 1 of the NISM Series XIX-B (Category III AIF Distributors) workbook, on which base are management fees explicitly computed for the illustrated Category III AIF?

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 6 Example 1 (pp.166-167 of the workbook) computes management fees on Gross NAV (GNAV) and explicitly states that management fees are NOT charged on committed capital or capital contributions in that example. The stem is now anchored to that example, so GNAV is uniquely correct. The Trap: Drawn-down capital and distributable profits are not the fee base in the example. Committed capital is the trap: the earlier general fee discussion (pp.56-57) does mention 1%-2% of committed capital during the commitment period, but Chapter 6 Example 1 specifically overrides that for the illustrated Category III AIF. The audit flagged the original because the binary stem invited both committed-capital and GNAV answers to be defended. Note: The original was ambiguous because the workbook itself has an internal fee-base tension between pp.56-57 (committed capital, general) and pp.166-167 (GNAV, Chapter 6 Example 1). The stem has been anchored to Chapter 6 Example 1, which uniquely supports the GNAV answer.
